definitions.definition: The magnitude of the induced electromotive force (emf) across a conductor is directly proportional to the rate of change of magnetic flux linkage.
distractors: The magnitude of the induced current is inversely proportional to the rate of change of magnetic flux.
The induced emf is equal to the product of magnetic field strength and the cross-sectional area.
The direction of an induced current is always such that it opposes the change in magnetic flux.
The total magnetic flux through a closed surface is always zero.
The force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field is proportional to the current and the magnetic field.
The maximum energy provided by a battery per unit charge passing through it.

definitions.definition: The product of the number of turns on the coil and the magnetic flux through the area of the loop.
distractors: The product of the strength of the magnetic field and the surface area perpendicular to the field.
The rate at which the magnetic field lines are cut by a rotating coil.
The force exerted on a charged particle moving through a magnetic field.
The total amount of magnetic field lines produced by a permanent magnet.
The ratio of magnetic flux to the current flowing through a coil.
The maximum induced electromotive force in a coil.

definitions.definition: The product of the strength of the magnetic field and the surface area perpendicular to the field ($\Phi = BA\cos\theta$).
distractors: The product of the number of turns on the coil and the magnetic flux through the area of the loop.
The total number of magnetic field lines passing parallel to the surface area.
The rate of change of the magnetic field passing through a coil.
The force exerted on a current-carrying conductor perpendicular to a magnetic field.
The potential difference induced across a rotating coil.
The product of the current in a coil and the number of turns.

definitions.definition: The direction of an induced current is always such that it establishes a magnetic field that opposes the change in magnetic flux that induced it.
distractors: The magnitude of the induced electromotive force is directly proportional to the rate of change of magnetic flux linkage.
The induced current will always flow in the direction of the changing magnetic field.
The magnetic field produced by a current is always perpendicular to the direction of the current.
A current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field experiences a force perpendicular to both the field and the current.
The total magnetic flux through any closed surface is always zero.
The mechanical force opposes the rotation of the coil in an electric motor.

definitions.definition: The interaction between the magnetic field of a current-carrying conductor and an external magnetic field, resulting in a mechanical force on the conductor.
distractors: The conversion of mechanical energy into electrical energy using electromagnetic induction.
The induction of an electromotive force due to a changing magnetic flux.
The generation of heat when alternating current passes through a resistor.
The process by which a split-ring commutator converts AC to DC.
The alignment of magnetic domains within a ferromagnetic material.
The attraction between two parallel conductors carrying current in the same direction.

definitions.definition: A device that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy.
distractors: A device that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy.
A device that steps up or steps down alternating voltage.
A component that ensures the current in an external circuit flows in one direction.
A device that measures the rate of change of magnetic flux.
A machine that stores electrical energy in the form of a magnetic field.
A component that reverses the direction of current in a coil every half-cycle.

definitions.definition: A device that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy.
distractors: A device that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy.
A device that induces an alternating current by rotating a coil in a magnetic field.
A component used to step down the voltage in the national power grid.
A device that generates a permanent magnetic field using carbon brushes.
A machine that converts alternating current (AC) into direct current (DC).
A component that ensures current flows continuously through slip rings.

definitions.definition: The value of an alternating current that will produce the same heating effect (or dissipate the same average power) in a given resistor as a direct current (DC) of the same value.
distractors: The maximum possible current produced by an alternating current generator.
The average value of the alternating current over one complete cycle.
The current that flows through the internal resistance of the generator.
The current measured across the slip rings of an AC generator.
The instantaneous current at the moment the coil is parallel to the magnetic field.
The direct current (DC) equivalent that produces half the average power.

definitions.definition: The value of an alternating potential difference that will produce the same heating effect (or dissipate the same average power) in a given resistor as a direct potential difference (DC) of the same value.
distractors: The maximum potential difference measured across the terminals of an AC generator.
The average potential difference of an alternating current over one complete cycle.
The constant voltage supplied by a battery in an external circuit.
The potential difference generated when the coil is perpendicular to the magnetic field.
The instantaneous voltage that produces zero current in a circuit.
The potential difference lost due to internal resistance in the generator.

proportionality.statement: In an AC generator, if the speed of rotation of the coil is doubled, the maximum induced electromotive force ($V_{max}$) will...
distractors: halve.
quadruple.
remain the same.
increase by a factor of 4.
decrease exponentially.
become zero.

proportionality.statement: If the number of turns on the coil of an AC generator is doubled, the maximum induced emf will...
distractors: halve.
quadruple.
remain the same.
decrease by a factor of 4.
increase exponentially.
become zero.

proportionality.statement: When a coil is positioned parallel to the magnetic field lines in an AC generator, the rate of change of magnetic flux is...
proportionality.correct: at a maximum, resulting in maximum induced emf.
distractors: zero, resulting in zero induced emf.
at a maximum, but the induced emf is zero.
zero, but the induced emf is at a maximum.
constant throughout the entire rotation.
equal to the magnetic flux.
independent of the speed of rotation.

proportionality.statement: When a coil is positioned perpendicular to the magnetic field lines in an AC generator, the induced emf is...
proportionality.correct: zero, because the rate of change of magnetic flux is zero.
distractors: at a maximum, because the magnetic flux is at a maximum.
at a maximum, because the rate of change of magnetic flux is zero.
zero, because the magnetic flux is zero.
equal to the product of the magnetic field and the area.
constant and non-zero.
inversely proportional to the magnetic flux.

concepts.question: Which specific component in a DC generator ensures that the induced alternating current in the coil is delivered as a pulsating direct current in the external circuit?
distractors: The slip rings.
The carbon brushes.
The armature coil.
The permanent magnets.
The step-up transformer.
The alternating current.

concepts.question: Which specific component in an AC generator provides continuous electrical contact while allowing the output current to alternate direction every half-cycle?
distractors: The split-ring commutator.
The carbon brushes.
The armature coil.
The permanent magnets.
The step-up transformer.
The direct current.

concepts.question: What is the primary function of the carbon brushes in both generators and motors?
concepts.correct: To maintain continuous electrical contact between the rotating coil/rings and the stationary external circuit.
distractors: To reverse the direction of the current in the coil every half-rotation.
To convert mechanical energy into electrical energy.
To step up the voltage before transmission over the national grid.
To provide the external magnetic field required for the motor effect.
To prevent the coil from rotating too quickly and overheating.
To convert alternating current into direct current.

concepts.question: Why is alternating current (AC) preferred over direct current (DC) for long-distance national grid electricity transmission?
concepts.correct: AC voltages can be easily stepped up by transformers, reducing transmission current and significantly minimizing heat energy loss ($P = I^2R$) in the cables.
distractors: AC requires thicker and heavier transmission cables, which are more durable over long distances.
AC flows much faster than DC, ensuring electricity reaches consumers instantly.
AC cannot cause electric shocks, making it significantly safer for long-distance lines.
DC voltages are always too low to travel more than a few kilometers without stopping.
Transformers require a constant, unchanging magnetic flux, which only AC can provide.
AC generates less heat in domestic appliances compared to DC.

concepts.question: According to Fleming's Left-Hand Rule for electric motors, what does the first finger (index finger) point towards?
concepts.correct: The direction of the magnetic field (from North to South).
distractors: The direction of the current (from Positive to Negative).
The direction of the motion or force on the conductor.
The direction of the induced electromotive force.
The direction of the electron flow (from Negative to Positive).
The direction of the magnetic flux linkage.
